LNG export marine terminal (2 x 225,000 m3, 2 berths, 28 MTPA)
Berth 2 arms on the platform, south to north: LA-5101 liquid, LA-5102 vapour, LA-5103 hybrid, LA-5104 liquid
(S-01); drawn left to right L, L, H, V. 16 inch, ~4,000 m3/h per liquid arm; the hybrid runs as the third liquid arm (D-014).
ERS per arm: two ball valves either side of the emergency release coupler. UZ: see C&E I-501 (ESD-1), I-503 (ESD-2).
Vapour arm connected first and disconnected last (S-01). BOG-5003, DR-5002, LNG-5005: see the line list.
